subject: Fix Valkey binary build workflow, version support changes. (#1429)
reason: The change modifies only CI/build infrastructure: .github/workflows/call-build-linux-x86-packages.yml changes the GitHub Actions runner label, and utils/releasetools/build-config.json updates the Ubuntu distro package build matrix. No server, replication, persistence, command, or tool code is touched, so there is no runtime behaviour a fuzzer scenario could reach or test.
